newsitem.title: INDIA: India RBI buys dlr at 35.70 to brake rupee's rise.
newsitem.headline: India RBI buys dlr at 35.70 to brake rupee's rise.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) bought dollars in early Monday trade to arrest the rupee's rise against the U.S. currency, dealers said.
"He (RBI) just now bought from me at 35.70 (rupees)," the chief dealer at a Bombay bank told Reuters.
The rupee was trading below the 35.70-mark on Monday.
Early deals were at 35.6950 and 35.6925 rupees per dollar.
The RBI was defending this level throughout last week by buying dollars at a band of 35.70 and 35.73 rupees.
The central bank intervened in early morning trade on Monday, in contrast to its late evening purchases last week, dealers said.
